title: Asset and Account Inventory
description: Record every account, property, and policy in one place so your executor or trustee can find everything without months of searching.
intro: An up-to-date inventory is one of the most useful things you can leave your family. For each item, note where it is held, how it is titled, and who the beneficiary is. Store the list somewhere safe and tell your executor where it is.

sections.heading: Bank accounts
items: List each checking account with bank name and last four digits
List each savings and money market account
List each certificate of deposit and its maturity date
Note how each account is titled: your name, joint, or trust
Note any payable-on-death beneficiary

sections.heading: Investments and retirement
items: List each brokerage account with firm name and last four digits
List each 401(k), 403(b), or other employer plan
List each traditional and Roth IRA
List pensions and annuities with contact information
Note the current primary and contingent beneficiary for each
List stock options, restricted stock, or employee stock plans

sections.heading: Real estate and vehicles
items: List each property with address and how it is titled
Note mortgage lender and approximate balance for each property
List each vehicle, boat, or trailer with title location
Note any transfer-on-death registration on deeds or vehicles

sections.heading: Insurance
items: List each life insurance policy with insurer, policy number, and death benefit
Note the owner and beneficiaries of each life policy
List long-term care, disability, and annuity policies
List home, auto, and umbrella policies with agent contact

sections.heading: Business and other assets
items: List business interests with ownership percentage and key documents
List money owed to you, such as personal loans
List valuable collections, jewelry, art, or firearms
List cryptocurrency holdings and where access details are stored
Note any expected inheritance or trust you are a beneficiary of

sections.heading: Debts
items: List each mortgage and home equity loan
List each credit card with issuer
List car loans, student loans, and personal loans
Note any debts you co-signed for someone else
